Spell Casting Check punishes haste - failure costs the slot without effect.

GMs: Enforce the DC 10 plus spell tier check; failure costs the slot, so remind them before they roll.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Mercurial Magic changes spellcasting unpredictably - each spell gains a unique quirk for the wizard who learns.

Judges: Remind your wizards to roll on the d100 Mercurial Magic table and note each spell's quirk in their grimoire.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Hobgoblin's Phalanx talent changes the odds - +1 to attacks and AC when in close range of an allied hobgoblin.

GMs: Force players to split the hobgoblins with area effects; deny them their +1 Phalanx bonus by breaking formation.

Attack Rolls determine hit success - they must meet or exceed the target's Armor Class.

DMs: Ensure attack rolls meet or exceed Armor Class for everyone, or prepare for the inevitable whining.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Halfling Luck economy outperforms other classes - burns at d3 intervals with the highest starting Luck.

Judges: Make your halfling's once-per-session Luck die count by using it on critical rolls before they happen, not after.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Sea Wolf's Old Gods talent offers a surprising tactical edge - each rest, align with a god for unique.

GMs: Remind players that aligning with Odin for 1d4 HP per kill beats flashy but inconsistent upgrades.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Scorching Ray often feels underwhelming - 2d6 fire damage per ray isn't much without advantage.

DMs: Use Scorching Ray when enemies are restrained to exploit advantage on attack rolls and avoid wasting a 2nd-level slot.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Judges: Make them sweat by exploiting the hatchling's fire immunity and force them to adapt with non-fire tactics.

Willowman forces a morale check on normally immune creatures - even undead must roll.

GMs: Use Willowman to force a morale check on level 2 undead, breaking their immunity and shifting the fight.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Reef Shark's Pack Tactics often surprises parties - advantage triggers when an ally is within 5 feet.

DMs: Maintain the sharks' 5-foot adjacency for Pack Tactics advantage; players, break their formation to negate it.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Weapon-breaker does more than just damage - it destroys the opponent's weapon on a crit.

Judges: Time Weapon-breaker's crit to destroy a key opponent's weapon, turning their advantage into a liability.

Advantage and Disadvantage confuse players - they never stack.

GMs: Remind them advantage and disadvantage don't stack; one cancels the other, leaving a single roll.
